items.title: After the midterm rout, Trump makes Stephen Miller chief of staff
items.summary: Three days after Republicans lost both chambers of Congress, Trump announced on Truth Social Friday that Stephen Miller, the architect of his mass-deportation campaign, would replace Susie Wiles as White House chief of staff on Monday; Wiles had resigned Thursday night and posted that Friday was her last day. Trump War Room posted this black-and-white photo of Miller with "It's Miller time," Miller's "honored beyond words" post drew 160K likes and Pete Hegseth's "Patriots in control." 133K, while Hakeem Jeffries called Miller's presence in government a "malignant tumor" and even Republicans like Thom Tillis and Don Bacon called it a bad choice. Miller's Wikipedia page jumped from about 10K daily views to 220K and then 374K. Earlier that day the feed had been dunking on the Cybertruck, which Elon Musk said overnight would be discontinued ("a useful way to learn who the dumbest, most gullible people were in your parents' neighborhood," 55K likes).
items.author: @TrumpWarRoom
